{{Top|leg}}
'''Conductive nets''' were a form of [[Ssi-ruu]]k technology. Ssi-ruuk [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] were inferior to the galactic standard, and power surges from enemy fire were likely to cause heavy damage. The Ssi-ruuk used conductive nets to absorb power surges and limit gravitational and inertial disruptions.
